lines.text: The root is Cur! Currency, incur.
Did you know? Cur is Latin for run.
Currency: money that runs from hand to hand.
Quick quiz! Which means into plus run?

words.mean: money that runs from hand to hand
words.ex: The local currency is the dong.
Late payments will incur a fee of twenty dollars per month.
